ऊकार: Ūkāra — the fifth face of the fourteen faced god, Cariṣ-ṇava Manu of the pīta colour. Vā. 26. 37.
ऊरु: Ūru (I) — a son of Cākṣuṣa Manu; wife Āgneyī; father of six sons. Br. II. 36. 79, 106-8; M. 4. 41-3; Vā. 62. 67, 91, 92; Vi. III. 1. 29.
Ūru (II) — a son of Bhauma Manu. Vi. III. 2. 45.
ऊर्ज: Ūrja (I) — a son of Vatsara and Svarvīthi. Bhā. IV. 13. 12.
Ūrja (II) — month (Kārtika) sacred to Hari; with Iṣa forms śarat. Bhā. XII. 11. 44; Vā. 30. 9; Br. II. 13. 10; Vā. 52. 15; 62. 16
Ūrja (III) — a god of the Harita gaṇa. Br. IV. 1. 85.
Ūrja (IV) — a son of Auttama Manu. M. 9. 12.
Ūrja (V) — the originator of the Agnisambhava gaṇa of Apsaras. Vā. 69. 54.
Ūrja (VI) — the son of Sudhanvā, the powerful. Vā. 99. 225.
Ūrja (VII) — one of the seven sages of Śvārociṣa epoch. Vi. III. 1. 11.
Ūrja (VIII) — the son of Śuci and father of Śatadhvaja. Vi. IV. 5. 30-31.
Ūrja (IX) — a grāmaṇi with the sun in the spring. Vā. 52. 4.
Ūrjja — a Sudhāmana god. Br. II. 36. 28.
ऊर्जवह: Ūrjavaha — the son of Muni; father of Sanadvāja. Br. III. 64. 20; Vā. 89. 19.
ऊर्जश्री: Ūrjaśrī — a queen of Śaradṛtu. Br. IV. 32. 34.
ऊर्जस्: Ūrjas (I) — a son of Vasiṣṭha and a sage of the Svārociṣa epoch. Br. II. 36. 17.
Ūrjas (II) — one of the ten branches of the Harita group of devas. Vā. 100. 89.
ऊर्जस्तम्भ: Ūrjastambha — a sage of the Svārociṣa epoch. Bhā. VIII. 1. 20.
ऊर्जस्वती: Ūrjasvatī (I) — a daughter of Priyavrata and Barhiṣ-matī; wife of Śukra, and mother of Devayāni. Bhā. V. 1. 24 and 34.
ऊर्जस्वी: Ūrjasvī — a son of Bhautya Manu. Br. IV. 1. 115.
ऊर्ज्ज: Ūrjja — a Sudhāmana god. Br. II. 36. 28.
ऊर्ज्जन्त: Ūrjjanta — the sacred hill where was Vasiṣṭha's āśrama. Br. III. 13. 53.
ऊर्जा: Ūrjjā — the wife of Dakṣa. Vi. I. 7. 7.

Ūrj(j)ā — a daughter of Dakṣa and wife of Vasiṣṭha; mother of Citraketu and six other sons besides a daughter Puṇḍarīkā. Bhā. IV. 1. 40; X. 39. 55; Br. II. 9. 52 and 56; 11. 39; Vā. 10. 28, 32; 28. 34; Vi. I. 7. 25; 10. 12.
Ūrjjās — one of the 14 gaṇas of Apsaras, born of Agni. Br. III. 7. 19.
ऊर्ज्जा: Ūrjjā — the wife of Dakṣa. Vi. I. 7. 7.
Ūrjjās — one of the 14 gaṇas of Apsaras, born of Agni. Br. III. 7. 19.
ऊर्जावती: Ūrjāvatī — wife of Prāṇa — a Vasu. Bhā. VI. 6. 12.
ऊर्जित: Ūrjita — a son of Kārtavīrya Arjuna. Bhā. IX. 23. 27.
ऊर्ण: Ūrṇa (I) — the Yakṣa presiding over the month Puṣya. Bhā. XII. 11. 42.
Ūrṇas — a hill tribe. Br. II. 16. 67.
ऊर्णा: Ūrṇā (I) — the queen of Citraratha and mother of Samrāṭ. Bhā. V. 15. 14.
Ūrṇā (II) — had six sons through Marīci. Bhā. X. 85. 47.
ऊर्णनाभ: Ūrṇanābha — one of Danu's sons. Vā. 68. 9.
ऊर्णायु: Ūrṇāyu — a Mauneya Gandharva with Hemanta sun. Br. II. 23. 17; Vā. 52. 17; 69. 1; Vi. II. 10. 14.
ऊर्ध्वकेतु: Ūrdhvaketu (I) — the son of Sanadvāja, and father of Aja. Bhā. IX. 13. 22.
Ūrdhvaketu (II) — one of the eleven Rudras. Vā. 66. 69.
ऊर्ध्वकेश: Ūrdhvakeśa — a son and commander of Bhaṇḍa. Br. IV. 21. 81; 26. 47.
ऊर्ध्वकेशा: Ūrdhvakeśā(i) — a svara śakti. Br. IV. 44. 56 and 85.
ऊर्ध्वग: Ūrdhvaga — a son of Kṛṣṇa and Mādrī. Bhā. X. 61. 15.
ऊर्द्ध्वदृष्टि: Ūrddhvadṛṣṭi — the son of Śveta the Vānara, and father of Vyāghra and others. Br. III. 7. 180, 205.
ऊर्ध्वपुण्ड्रम्: Ūrdhvapuṇḍram — a caste mark on the forehead. Br. IV. 38. 22.
ऊर्ध्वबाहु: Ūrdhvabāhu (I) — a sage of the Raivata epoch; a son of Vasiṣṭha and Ūrjā. Bhā. VIII. 5. 3; Br. II. 11. 41; 36. 62; Vi. III. 1. 22.
Ūrdhvabāhu (II) — a son of Ūrja and Vasiṣṭha. Vi. I. 10. 13.
ऊर्ध्वभाग: Ūrdhvabhāga of Aṇḍa — above Brahmaloka 4 crores, 11 niyutas. Vā. 101. 143.
ऊर्ध्वमरु: Ūrdhvamaru — a region of the west watered by Sindhu. Br. II. 18. 49; Vā. 47. 46.
ऊर्ध्वरोमन्: Ūrdhvaroman — a hill of Kuśadvīpa. Bhā. V. 20. 15.
ऊर्ध्वस्रोतस्: Ūrdhvasrotas — relates to creation of Bhauta sarga, after Tiryak srotas; the seventh mānuṣa sarga, the sixth being daivata. Br. I. 5. 57; III. 7. 474; Vā. 6. 48-51.
ऊर्ध्वायन: Ūrdhvāyanas — a class of people in Plakṣadvīpa. Bhā. V. 20. 4.
ऊर्मिषड्कम्: Ūrmiṣaḍkam — the six ūrmis or waves as obstructing the knowledge of Brahman — hunger, thirst, sorrow, stupefac-tion, decay and death. Vi. I. 15. 37.
ऊर्मी: Ūrmī — a son of Soma. Br. III. 3. 23; Vā. 66. 23.
ऊर्व: Ūrva (I) — the son of Purañjaya; a sage who practised true brahmacarya; put his thigh into the fire and churned it with kuśa grass; out of that came the fire Aurva, which he gave to Hiraṇyakaśipu as a weapon. M. 50. 85; 175. 23-48, 69-71.
ऊर्वशी: Ūrvaśī — born out of the thigh of Nārāyaṇa. (See Urvaśī). Vā. 69. 51.
ऊषा: Ūṣā — (also Uṣā, s.v.) Daughter of Bāṇa. Her compa-nion was Citralekhā. Dreamt one night that she was sleeping with Aniruddha. Informed her friend of the dream but could not give Aniruddha's name. Citralekhā drew pencil sketches of all gods and men and showed them to her one by one. Seeing Aniruddha's she identified him. At this, Citralekhā flew through air and brought Aniruddha to her room unnoticed by others. Ūṣā was enjoying his company. The guards who got scent of this reported to Bāṇa who imprisoned Aniruddha. In course of time she married Ani-ruddha and went to his home with the approval of Bāṇa. Bhā. X. 61. 23 [9]; 62. 1-35; 63. 50.
ऊष्मप: Ūṣmapas (II) — a class of Pitṛs. Br. II. 27. 111; 28. 93.
ऊष्मय: Ūṣmayas — a class of Pitṛs. Br. II. 28. 23.
ऊष्माद: Ūṣmādas — a Parāśara clan. Br. III. 8. 95.
ऊसिज: Ūsija — a son of Śveta; an avatāra of the Lord. Vā. 23. 205.
ऊहम्: Ūham — a portion of Sāma Veda. Br. II. 35. 72.
